metadata.title: Force and Pressure
metadata.subtitle: Pushes and Pulls!
metadata.subject: Physics
metadata.author: Antigravity AI
learning_outcomes: Understand force as a push or pull

ai_context.learning_goal: Introduce Newton's concepts of force in everyday life.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Use opening a door as an example of push/pull.

content.text: In physics, a force is a push or a pull on an object resulting from its interaction with another object. Force is measured in Newtons (N).

content.question: What is the SI unit of Force?
